scenes.title: Warnings at Bhishma’s Temple
scenes.rationale: The temple survey and preparations end when Kenzo proposes direct reconnaissance of the undead presence.
scenes.overview: The party enters the desecrated temple and senses undead nearby.

scenes.title: Shadows and a Night’s Rest
scenes.rationale: Testing the shadows leads directly to withdrawal and recovery at camp; the next dawn begins a new decision.
scenes.overview: Kenzo tests the shadows against light; the party retreats and rests while Delwath hears distant armor.
scenes.transitionToNext: Dawn brings renewed plans for Kharsan.

scenes.title: Missing Orcs at Dawn
scenes.rationale: The morning discussion and Wellby’s investigation establish the reconnaissance goal and then reveal the threat that forces a route change.
scenes.overview: The party debates Kharsan; Wellby discovers missing bodies and approaching search parties.
scenes.transitionToNext: The party must choose an escape route.

scenes.title: The Southern Detour
scenes.rationale: The chosen route and its short travel montage form one decision-and-consequence sequence, ending in exhausted rest.
scenes.overview: The party chooses a southern loop, rides around the cliffs, and camps after a tiring forced march.
scenes.transitionToNext: They rise before dawn to approach Kharsan from the west.

scenes.title: Approaching Kharsan
scenes.rationale: Aerial scouting, mount concealment, and the stealthy approach establish the reconnaissance position at the bridge.
scenes.overview: A hawk reveals stronger patrols and a shadowed palace; the party conceals its mounts and reaches the bridge.
scenes.transitionToNext: Seeker and Delwath begin simultaneous reconnaissance.

scenes.title: Grash and the Haunted Ruins
scenes.rationale: Seeker’s palace surveillance and Delwath’s parallel exploration are parts of one reconnaissance mission, closing with reunion at the bridge.
scenes.overview: Seeker witnesses Grash’s necromancy and war plans while Delwath explores the haunted ruins and retrieves glassware.
